# moq_signing_key (Resource)

A key that signs the media tokens publishers and viewers present to the relay. Either generate one with `algorithm`, or register your own with `public_key` and sign tokens yourself.

A key is immutable: changing anything but `enabled` replaces it, which invalidates every token it signed.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A generated key: the API keeps it, and private_key holds the secret.
resource "moq_signing_key" "publish" {
  project_id = moq_project.example.id
  algorithm  = "HS256"
  label      = "publishers"
  publish    = ["live/**"]
}

# Your own key pair: register the public half and sign tokens yourself.
resource "moq_signing_key" "external" {
  project_id = moq_project.example.id
  public_key = file("${path.module}/public.jwk")
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project_id` (String) The project's immutable ID.

### Optional

- `algorithm` (String) Generate a key for this algorithm. `HS*` keys are symmetric secrets; the others are asymmetric key pairs. Exactly one of `algorithm` and `public_key` is required.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the relay accepts tokens signed by this key. A key is disabled before it is deleted.
- `label` (String) Human-readable label. The API generates one when omitted.
- `public_key` (String) Register this public key, a serialized public JWK, instead of generating one. Private parameters are refused.
- `publish` (Set of String) Upper bound on the publish grants of tokens this key signs, as patterns relative to the project. Omit both `publish` and `subscribe` for no bound. Not available with `public_key`.
- `subscribe` (Set of String) Upper bound on the subscribe grants of tokens this key signs, as patterns relative to the project. Not available with `public_key`.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation time, RFC 3339.
- `id` (String) Key ID, the `kid` in tokens it signs.
- `key_type` (String) `symmetric` or `asymmetric`.
- `private_key` (String, Sensitive) The generated private key as a serialized JWK: the shared secret of an `HS*` key, or the private half of a key pair. A symmetric key's secret is always readable, including after an import. An asymmetric private key is returned only at creation, so an imported one leaves this null. Null for `public_key` keys.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by project ID and key ID.
terraform import moq_signing_key.publish p123example/8f14e45f-ceea-467f-a9c8-0e1c4e3a8b4d
```
